title: American artists in Paris and the Hot Club of France
summary: Lizzie Miles, Elisabeth Welch, Florence Mills, Johnny Dunn, and visiting the Hot Club of France.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Were you in Paris when Lizzie Miles was there? Yes. You were? Wasn't she called the Black Rose in Paris? Something like that.

I knew all those artists that came over. One is in, I can't remember their name, Elizabeth Wells. Did you do any blonde with, any groups with her? Well, in nightclubs I played with Elizabeth Wells. You never heard of Florence Mill? Yeah. Well, I met her too when she came to Europe. I think it was in the same outfit that Esham Joan was with. Johnny Dunn came over.
Johnny Dunn, there was that swinging cat. Yes.
Did you play with him? I met him. Well, and I didn't play with him, but I heard him play. He had that long trumpet, you know. He was a good showman. He was a good showman.
I prize those records I've got of him and Garvin Bouchelle on clarinet. Yeah. Yeah. Did you keep in touch with Hotline Records or what, the scene over here? Because you've heard of these guys.
Well, I used to belong to the, while I was over there, I belonged to the Hot Club of France and was traveling. Was that Pernacier's?
Was that Pernacier's deal? Yes. Pernacier.
Oh, yeah. Pierre Nourie, the women Pernacier, is the one that started the Hot Club of France. And so I used to go to the house and listen to the ladies and things they had.
